connectivity_cross_check.policy: Named schematic nets are compared with PCB pad nets using matching pin/pad numbers; root-sheet local labels also allow KiCad's leading '/' prefix.

reasons: ESP32-DevKitC is a combined 38-pad carrier/header footprint, not an additional DevKit board: the source photo shows two 19-pin male headers. Both headers already exist as electronic_connector_header_2_54_mm_pitch_through_hole_19_pin, but a one-footprint-to-two-parts mapping needs confirmation. Do not buy another DevKitC.
